this_court: Futility of raising a statutory-change claim (here, Rehaif) does not establish cause to excuse procedural default; the court aligns with the circuits cited that reject futility as cause, and distinguishes the contrary cases as involving constitutional changes where the Supreme Court overruled itself.
quote: When other circuits have disagreed, the claims at issue generally addressed changes in constitutional law where the Supreme Court reversed itself.
cite: United States v. Tyronne Pollard, Jr., 20 F.4th 1252 (9th Cir. 2021)
